name: Jam
description: Turn Jam bug reports into Weaver issues, link Jams to issues, and request recordings from issues
author: Weaver

uninstall.confirmationMessage: Uninstalling Jam deletes the Jam inbox, every Jam link, recording requests, and routing rules in Weaver. Jams in Jam are not changed.

declaredPermissions.label: View Jams
declaredPermissions.description: See Jams, their debug summaries, and recording requests on issues you can read

declaredPermissions.label: Link Jams
declaredPermissions.description: Attach, unlink, and request Jam recordings on issues you can edit

declaredPermissions.label: Triage Jams
declaredPermissions.description: Work the Jam inbox and create issues from Jams

declaredPermissions.label: Administer Jam
declaredPermissions.description: Manage the Jam connection and routing rules

jamWorkspaceId.label: Jam workspace ID
jamWorkspaceId.description: From the Jam settings URL: jam.dev/s/<workspace ID>/settings

jamApiToken.label: Jam personal access token
jamApiToken.description: A jam_pat_ token with the mcp:read and mcp:write scopes

jamAccessExpiresOn.label: Token expiry date
jamAccessExpiresOn.description: YYYY-MM-DD, shown in Jam when the token was created

jamWebhookSecret.label: Webhook signing secret
jamWebhookSecret.description: The whsec_ secret from the endpoint in Jam's webhook portal

recordingLinkUrl.label: Reusable recording link
recordingLinkUrl.description: A reusable Jam recording link, such as https://recorder.jam.dev/AbC123x. Recording requests from issues add a signed reference to it.

postBacklinkComments.label: Comment on linked Jams
postBacklinkComments.description: Post the Weaver issue link as a comment on each linked Jam

showDebugSummary.label: Show debug summaries
showDebugSummary.description: Show console errors and failed requests from Jam on issues. Anyone who can read the issue sees them.

showTranscript.label: Show what reporters said
showTranscript.description: Add the spoken transcript of video Jams recorded with the microphone on to the debug summary. Anyone who can read the issue sees it. Needs Show debug summaries.

embedPlayer.label: Embed the Jam player
embedPlayer.description: Offer Jam's player on issues. It plays only Jams shared with anyone who has the link.

notifyJamOnResolve.label: Comment on Jams when issues are resolved
notifyJamOnResolve.description: Post a comment, mentioning whoever captured the Jam, when a linked issue moves to a done status

autoCreateHourlyLimit.label: Issues a rule may create per hour
autoCreateHourlyLimit.description: Default cap for routing rules that create issues; over the cap, Jams wait in the inbox
